description: ENHANCED: Batch-oriented codec adapter edge cases — an empty chunk list yielding zero batches, multiple chunks each forming their own batch, a maxRowsPerBatch cap that exactly divides the row count, a cap of one combined with a split CRLF across chunks, auto-detection that buffers a prefix before emitting its first batch, and a chunk that decodes to zero rows (blank lines skipped) emitting no batch.

cases.expected_output:
batches=3
batch[0] rows=1: [ str="a" | str="b" ]
batch[1] rows=1: [ str="c" | str="d" ]
batch[2] rows=1: [ str="e" | str="f" ]

batches=2
batch[0] rows=2: [ str="1" | str="a" ] [ str="2" | str="b" ]
batch[1] rows=2: [ str="3" | str="c" ] [ str="4" | str="d" ]

batches=2
batch[0] rows=1: [ str="a" | str="b" ]
batch[1] rows=1: [ str="c" | str="d" ]

batches=1

batches=1
batch[0] rows=2: [ str="a" | str="b" ] [ str="c" | str="d" ]
